Work history, education and spoken languages: facts no repository holds, written by the owner (ADR 0004).

data/experience.json, written by scripts/mine-experience.mjs and checked by scripts/check-experience.mjs. Every engagement is under a legal NDA: it holds a neutral id, keys of the public vocabulary in data/experience-rules.toml, dates, rounded numbers and public technology names, nothing else. No name, path or free text.

Every content/*.md carries this front matter (TOML). It drives the page's title, SEO, Open Graph and Twitter tags, OG image, JSON-LD and its place in the site; nothing about a page is typed in a template. Validated by scripts/check-front-matter.mjs.
